## Summary

**Issue:** checkout-api was failing health checks after the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Investigated** — `get_service_status` showed v2.3.1 deployed in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with `healthy: false` and error rate 0.18. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was also healthy but older).

2. **Rolled back to v2.3.0** — The first rollback attempt partially completed (us-east) but halted due to an orchestrator error. I retried and the rollback completed successfully across all regions: us-east, us-west, and eu-west are now on v2.3.0.

3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** — Incident **INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy") was created and is open, describing the unhealthy deploy and the rollback to v2.3.0.

**Final state:** checkout-api is on v2.3.0 in all regions, `healthy: true`, error rate 0.002.
